adjudication.rationale: In `packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts`, inside the new loop over `bookingCalendarReference`, when `reference.credentialId` is set the code tries to find `calendarCredential` in `bookingToDelete.user.credentials`, then falls back to `prisma.credential.findUnique`. If that DB lookup also returns `null`, `calendarCredential` remains undefined and the code simply skips the deletion because it only proceeds under `if (calendarCredential) { ... apiDeletes.push(...) }` with no `else` logging or failure result. This matches the finding: the cancellation completes without deleting that remote calendar event and without any trace as to why.
